查询失败与缺失凭据优先；状态未知时先重试查询，不能认定密钥不存在。: Failed lookups and missing credentials appear first. Retry unknown states before treating a key as missing.
生成不含凭据的普通 JSON 文件，供迁移或恢复使用。: Create a plain JSON file without credentials for migration or recovery.
先了解覆盖范围，再选择文件并确认导入。: Review what may be replaced, then select a file and confirm the import.
普通配置 JSON 的范围: Scope of the plain configuration JSON
同 ID 配置可能被更新，MCP 选择可能同步到客户端，启用的路由配置可能启动监: Configurations with matching IDs may be updated, MCP selections may sync to clients, and enabled routing may start listening. Confirmation is required after selecting a file.
选择要恢复的交换备份: Select an exchange backup to restore
自启设置写入后回读实际状态，下次登录系统时使用。: Autostart is read back after saving to confirm its actual state. It applies at the next system login.
先修改草稿，再保存；各项的生效时机分别列出。: Edit the draft, then save. Each preference lists when it takes effect.
浏览器预览草稿，不代表本机已保存策略: Browser preview draft; this does not represent the policy saved on this device
当前策略与已保存值一致: The current policy matches the saved values
修改输入或策略会立即清除旧预览；保存前可先核对脱敏结果。: Changing the input or policy clears the previous preview immediately. Review redaction results before saving.
调整外观、语言与应用行为: Adjust appearance, language and app behavior
主题和语言立即保存；请求与日志分别在下次启动路由、重启应用后生效。: Theme and language are saved immediately. Request preferences apply at the next router start; logging preferences apply after an app restart.
检查运行、恢复接管或修改路由配置: Check runtime status, restore client configuration or edit routing
运行状态以回读为准；接管与恢复会修改对应客户端配置。: Runtime status comes from a fresh read. Takeover and restoration modify the corresponding client configuration.
处理缺失凭据或查询失败: Resolve missing credentials or failed lookups
这里只查询存在状态；进入对应供应商编辑器后再保存密钥变更。: This page only checks whether credentials exist. Open the corresponding provider editor to save key changes.
编辑保护策略并在本地预览: Edit the protection policy and preview it locally
预览使用当前草稿；保存的策略在每次代理发送前读取。: The preview uses the current draft. The saved policy is read before each proxy request is sent.
备份或恢复普通配置 JSON: Back up or restore plain configuration JSON
文件不含凭据；确认导入后写入，失败时可能已经完成部分配置。: The file excludes credentials. Writes begin after import confirmation; some configuration may already be applied if an error occurs.
审核加密交换冲突或恢复交换备份: Review encrypted exchange conflicts or restore an exchange backup
选择对象、核对差异并完成确认后提交；退出清理口令和票据。: Select objects, review differences and confirm before applying. Leaving clears passphrases and review tickets.
选择要完成的任务，进入后查看实际状态与生效方式。: Choose a task to review its actual state and when changes take effect.
操作进行中，请等待结果后离开。: An operation is in progress. Wait for its result before leaving.
未保存的草稿将丢弃，敏感输入和审核票据会清理。已完成的写入不会撤销。: Unsaved drafts will be discarded, and sensitive inputs and review tickets will be cleared. Completed writes will not be undone.
